scope: Revolve Output=SubD, SegmentCount, automatic Greville profile fitting, native history and interactive output switching.

geometry_comparison.correspondence: Unique geometric control vertices, tagged edge incidence and oriented face cycles. Every oriented density-2 limit quad is paired across different display buffers; the 1e-6 lookup grid does not relax the comparison epsilon.

checks: Natural and periodic angular fits; positive, negative and partial turns; counts below four clamp to four.
Greville profile sampling for degrees one through four, rational weights, multiple knots, active domains, closed and periodic profiles.
Axis contact/crossing, pole fans, spatial axes, small models and million-unit translations.
Global crease admission and hidden Surface options leave SubD output unchanged.
Source retention/deletion, selection, Undo/Redo, output modes, cancellation and atomic invalid option groups.
3DM preserves control positions, face/edge topology and tags; native limit geometry and normal-aware meshing remain valid.
Current-layer output, source attributes/groups, mixed-profile failure rollback and a 1001-segment construction.
Shared cubic collocation retains existing ToSubD conversion and command behavior in both builds.
limits: The native profile fit can substantially change source geometry; a single cubic Bezier can become a line.
Native control-vertex, edge and display-buffer numbering are not reproduced; geometric correspondence is verified.
Options reset per invocation. Continuous error bounds, arbitrary topology and comparative performance remain unqualified.
Construction is bounded by 100000 SubD control vertices and faces per result.
capture_environment: Five owned private Xvfb captures. All native command probes explicitly set/restore request document tolerances. App tests removed desktop display/compositor variables. Frozen request and producer hashes passed verification; compression preserves exact observation bytes.
